name: Birch Haven Campground
evidence: satellite 44.2232,-76.1274 (leaf-off, 0.24 m/px) + operator aerial: park runs N from Rt 12E pin to the St. Lawrence; front-row trailers ~40-45 m from water behind a wooded climb-down bank (stairs to docks), not on-water; operator photos from the grounds show open river views -> riverview

name: Cedar Point State Park
evidence: RA per-site 'Proximity to Water: Waterfront' on 13 sites, but RA site map puts 006-020 inside the loop, across the shore drive (tag is distance-only); only 003-005 (2 tent, 1 20-ft trailer) sit shore-side and no pad shows on z19/NYS ortho; ~20-25 m open grass + drive to riprap -> riverview

name: Frontier Town Campground
evidence: NYS ortho 43.9372,-73.7405 + RA site map (74 sites, no Proximity to Water): Prairie Junction pads nearest the Schroon River ~40-75 m back behind continuous pine forest, no sightline; RA's 'on the shores' is property-level

name: Myers Park
evidence: Lansing campsite map + NYS ortho 42.5390,-76.5458: sites 13-19 pads ~20-25 m from Salmon Creek across open grass with scattered trees; creek ~30-35 m wide (river by size); Cayuga Lake ~300 m W with no site on it, so lakefront not earned

name: Limekiln Lake Campground
evidence: RA site map (getSVGFragment) draws 016-021, 003-005 and 098-116/126-129 between the shore road and Limekiln Lake; NYS ortho 43.7158,-74.8128: shore-road pads ~15-30 m from water under thin conifer fringe; RA pages carry no Proximity attribute (the 'no' icon is not a 'no')

name: Oneida Shores Park
evidence: county camping page: 'Waterfront' sites are tents only; satellite 43.2266,-76.1093: RV loop by the launch parking ~120-150 m from Oneida Lake behind solid woods and parking, no sightline

name: Rancho Pines Campground
evidence: Campspot per-site map draws the bookable W/E/S RV cluster beside the Schroon River (~15 m, scaled by the verifier from road-to-river width); NYS 2018 ortho 43.6547,-73.7621: an RV on the riverside lane ~17-20 m from water under pine canopy. Hand-scaled drawn map + canopy -> verifier proposed riverfront at low confidence; coordinator held it at riverview (default down)

name: Royal Mountain Campsites
evidence: ResNexus site map: 16, 17 and lettered sites between the north driveway and the pond (site 16 'pull-through ... by the pond'); Esri z19 43.0452,-74.5245: trailer on a north pad ~15 m from the pond across open unused lawn
